ios.desc:
This app is a progress indicator for your goals.

App icon changes according to your progress! Widget for the app will help you to track progress.

Want to save up for a large purchase? For example, a house, car or education. Or you want to achieve some other measurable goal. For example make 300 workouts in a year. This app will help you. You can always see how far you have gone and how much is left to your goal. Just set your goal and track progress.

The progress indicator is a quiet reminder on your screen. Keep on striving toward your goal!

Features:
- Widgets
- Apple Watch extension
- Decimal goal value
- You can increase and decrease progress
- You can update your goal details
- You can repeat progress changes
